assets.label: export transfer pumps

control_failures.control_label: controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels

facts.title: improvement notice - critical control at P-7112

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was medical treatment injury, with 1 person injured.

defences.finding: Control HYDROCARBON_TRANSFER_CONTROL: the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels had been bypassed, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Confirm at the next critical control verification that the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels on P-7112, M-7112 and TK-7103 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in responding to a loss of containment, specifically isolating and depressuring a leaking system. P-7112 (export transfer pumps) is in service for tank-to-jetty product transfer, same seal class as the Marrindal family. The task proceeded during commissioning of replacement equipment while the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels had been bypassed. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 9 October 2016 a regulatory notice was issued concerning P-7112, M-7112 and TK-7103 at Cape Verity Export Terminal following commissioning of replacement equipment.
